note: The setup's first extractor and actions (2263 s).
instructions:
Play the game well. Super Coin Box. Use the arrow keys: Left and Right to run, Up to jump. Grab the coin; a new one appears somewhere else each time. Enemies keep coming down from the top: landing on one from above kills it, touching it any other way costs a life. You have three lives. Collect as many coins as you can.
Each of ifIdle, ifLeft, ifRight, ifJump, ifJumpLeft, ifJumpRight predicts what happens if that action is held for the next 0.1 s and play then continues sensibly. safe = true means some continuation avoids every enemy, the bottom pit and the top of the world for 1.4 s. eta = predicted seconds until the coin is touched (smaller is better; 50 or more means no known route yet; 99 means no coin). kills = true means a safe continuation stomps an enemy. hitIn = the longest you can last before contact when the action is not safe (9 when safe). Rules: 1) If playing is false (menu, between lives, gameOver), choose jump or click, 50/50. 2) Otherwise consider only the actions whose ifX.safe is true and pick the smallest ifX.eta. Go through them in the order idle, right, left, jumpRight, jumpLeft, jump, and switch to a later action only if its eta is more than 0.04 smaller, or it is within 0.04 and has kills = true while the current pick does not. 3) If no action is safe, pick the largest hitIn (on a tie, the smaller eta), in the same order. 4) If the ifX fields are missing, go right when coinDx > 10, left when coinDx < -10, otherwise idle. Context fields: enemies = the 3 nearest threats (dx, dy from the player; positive dy = below), pitBelow = nothing solid under the player, coinEta = best safe eta, graphReady = the route map is complete.
